pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with jagged, star-like perimeters. Pixel gradients at the edges are soft and diffused. Spatial area is greater in the dorsal patches compared to the smaller, fragmented patches on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light beige pathways with predominantly tri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness is consistent across the mid-flank but becomes less defined in the overexposed ventral areas.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, upright mane along the neck with a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A small avian figure, likely an oxpecker, is perched on the upper neck/shoulder region in the upper-left quadrant.
